champion.tips: AMBESSA TIPS AND TRICKS Try to keep the minion wave even or closer to your tower. Freezing allows you to abuse your insane mobility to take down champions who are positioned too far forward. When committing to an all-in, check your energy bar first. Commit to all-ins when you have a lot of energy, as your full combo may be interrupted if you lack energy. Ambessa benefits from extended trades. Instead of short ones, go for long trades where you can get multiple attacks off.
champion.builds: THE BEST AMBESSA BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR TOP IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Ambessa Top build, you should take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Grasp of the Undying as your keystone, followed by Shield Bash, Second Wind and Overgrowth in the primary tree, as well as Biscuit Delivery and Magical Footwear in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Eclipse as your first item, followed by Plated Steelcaps and Spear of Shojin. For your last 3 items, you should build Death's Dance, Sterak's Gage and finish with Guardian Angel. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 51.4% winrate over 31 095 matches played. Optional Your second option for Ambessa Top build would be to take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Conqueror as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Haste and Last Stand in the primary tree, and Overgrowth with Second Wind in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense. The items for the build are Eclipse, which you should build first, followed by Plated Steelcaps as your second item and Spear of Shojin as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Death's Dance, Sterak's Gage and Guardian Angel. The skill order for this build is Q - E - W. In the current patch, this build has a 51.6% win rate over 6 271 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Grasp of the Undying as your keystone, Shield Bash, Second Wind and Overgrowth in the primary tree, and Sudden Impact with Ultimate Hunter in the secondary tree, as well as Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, and Health as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Eclipse as your first item, then Plated Steelcaps as a second item and Voltaic Cyclosword as a third item. You want to finish the build with Spear of Shojin, Death's Dance and Guardian Angel. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - E - W. This build is currently sitting at a 54.8% win rate across 2 446 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Ambessa Top build in the current patch, try Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, Electrocute, Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos and Ultimate Hunter as your primary rune tree, and Shield Bash with Second Wind as your secondary tree. Use Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force and Health as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Eclipse as your first item, then finish Plated Steelcaps as your second item, and Spear of Shojin as third item. The last 3 options are Death's Dance, Maw of Malmortius and Guardian Angel. The ability order for this build is Q - E - W. As of the current patch, this build has a 48.9% win rate over 1 565 matches played. Situational Ambessa Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Ambessa build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Ambessa runes page.
